description: Merge a loser concept into a winner. Defaults to impact_only=true: inspect counts and affected replicas before obtaining approval to execute. impact_only=false requires owner and rewrites aliases, entity identities and referencing payloads, queuing convergence to linked replicas. No LLM call. Similarity alone does not establish identity; inspect get_semantic_concept and the judge review evidence first. Returns impact or merge results. See enricher://docs/semantic-ids.

impact_only.description: True = report the merge's blast radius only; False = merge (owner role).
impact_only.title: Impact Only

loser_id.description: semantic_id of the concept folded into the winner.
loser_id.title: Loser Id

winner_id.description: semantic_id of the concept that survives.
winner_id.title: Winner Id

name: merge_semantic_concepts
title: Merge semantic concepts
